title: Academy & Webinar
content_data:
Welcome to the guide on educational resources for the TikTok for Business MCP Server (also referred to as TikTok Ads MCP). This article highlights the curated selection of TikTok Academy courses and webinar sessions created to elevate your understanding and proficiency with our TikTok Ads MCP. By leveraging these comprehensive educational materials, you can unlock the potential of TikTok's automated marketing tools, ensuring more efficient and impactful campaign management. > **Note**
> TikTok Academy is the official TikTok learning destination for marketers and agencies. Through the academy, you can explore our catalog of e-learning courses, videos and webinars. You are encouraged to follow curated learning paths tailored for your business goals. Completing the courses and passing the final assessment earns you an official certificate to showcase your expertise. If you haven't registered for TikTok Academy yet, [register here](https://ads.tiktok.com/business/en/academy) to instantly unlock these free courses and webinars. Explore our top recommended resources below to empower your teams and refine your advertising capabilities: - [TikTok Academy course: Intro to Agentic AI for TikTok Advertisers](https://www.tiktokacademy.com/student/path/3639533-intro-to-agentic-ai-for-tiktok-advertisers): Explore TikTok's Ads MCP and learn how to build automated workflows using the Agentic Hub and Skills. - [TikTok Academy webinar: Putting AI Agents to Work: A Practical Guide to Agentic Marketing on TikTok](https://www.tiktokacademy.com/student/path/2852927/activity/5856166): Join TikTok and Perplexity for a practical look at how AI agents can streamline everyday work: planning, campaign creation, creative refresh, performance diagnosis, and next-step recommendations. - [TikTok Academy webinar: Putting AI Agents to Work: Powering Growth with TikTok Ads and Claude for Small Business](https://www.tiktokacademy.com/student/page/3663358-north-american-europe-putting-ai-agents-to-work-powering-growth-with-tiktok-ads-and-claude-for-small-business?utm_source=bdc&utm_medium=tta_mcp_article&utm_campaign=anthropic_MCP_261022_PMC_na&utm_content=webinar): Discover how AI agents are transforming small business advertising with TikTok and Anthropic. Learn about the latest TikTok for Business MCP updates and see how it seamlessly connects with the Claude for Small Business workflow.
